hero.statement: Teaching and advancing computing education equity through empirical research in Nigerian higher education, disseminated globally with African and Western research partners.

impactMetrics.label: Years in CS Education
impactMetrics.aria: Over thirty years of experience in computer science education, teaching since 1995

impactMetrics.label: Publications (2013–2026)
impactMetrics.aria: Sixteen journal articles, conference papers, and a book, published from 2013 to 2026

impactMetrics.label: Final-Year Projects Supervised
impactMetrics.aria: Over one hundred PGD, HND, and ND final-year research projects supervised

professionalMemberships.name: Senior Member, Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) — since 2011, Senior Member since 2021
Member, ACM Special Interest Group on Computer Science Education (SIGCSE) — since 2022
Full Member, Nigeria Computer Society — since 2005

researchInterests: Computing education in under-resourced African higher education
Novice programming achievement and gender equity in CS1
Generative AI in programming education and intelligent tutoring systems
Impostor phenomenon and professional dispositions in computing students

activeResearch.title: Integrating Professional Dispositions in Nigerian Polytechnic Computing Education
activeResearch.description: As Principal Investigator, leading a study developing a framework for enhanced graduate competency — using pre/post-surveys and reflective interventions to assess adaptability, collaboration, persistence, and self-directed learning among HND computing students, aligned with ACM CC2020 global competency frameworks. Funded by a ₦3.8M TETFund institutional grant.
activeResearch.status: Data collection, entry, and analysis complete · Manuscript in preparation for submission

activeResearch.title: International Impostor Phenomenon Study I
activeResearch.description: Led the Niger State Polytechnic site of an international multi-institutional study examining the impostor phenomenon among computing students, led by Prof. Leo Porter and Sophia Krause-Levy, in collaboration with partner institutions.
activeResearch.published: Conference paper presented at ACM CompEd 2025 (Best Paper Runner-Up); companion article under review at ACM Transactions on Computing Education (TOCE)

activeResearch.title: International Impostor Phenomenon Study II
activeResearch.description: A second multi-institutional impostor phenomenon study led by Prof. Andrew Petersen (University of Toronto Mississauga), with research instruments deployed on the Multi-Study Research Portal.
activeResearch.status: Ongoing · Data collection paused, resuming when students return for second semester at Niger State Polytechnic and partner institutions

activeResearch.title: AlgoLadder — Bilingual Computational Thinking Tutor
activeResearch.description: A bilingual (Hausa-English) computational thinking tutor for low-achieving novice computing students, built into a full multi-study research portal with a Node.js/Express backend and Supabase PostgreSQL database.
activeResearch.status: Developed and deployed on the MultiStudy Research Portal · Participation of schools solicited · Awaiting second semester resumption for data collection

news.headline: Best Paper Runner-Up at ACM CompEd 2025
news.content: Recognised among top submissions for "The Impostor Phenomenon Among Nigerian Computing Students: A Study of Prevalence, Gender, and Academic Progression," presented at the ACM Global Computing Education Conference in Gaborone, Botswana.

news.headline: 2025 Outstanding Reviewer, ACM SIGCSE Technical Symposium
news.content: Recognised by the conference program chairs for providing high-quality reviews on four research paper manuscripts submitted to the SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2025.

news.headline: TETFund-Funded Professional Dispositions Study Underway
news.content: Leading a ₦3.8M TETFund-sponsored study as Principal Investigator, developing a framework for integrating professional dispositions into Nigerian polytechnic computing education, aligned with ACM CC2020 competency frameworks.
